entry.title: PostgreSQL 18 released with async IO support
entry.summary: Beta reports that PostgreSQL 18 is out with asynchronous input-output enabled by default and faster vacuum runs on large tables.

entry.title: Hacker News thread about a new terminal editor written in Rust
entry.summary: A long discussion about a terminal editor written in Rust, its plugin model, startup time, and the way it keeps state between sessions.
